simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to סוּת (H5497) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: סוּת (çûwth) means covering , i.e. clothing First listed occurrence: Gen 49 11.

definitions.full: H5497. suth [ סוּת ] noun [masculine] vesture (Late Hebrew, but dubious; see Levy s. see ); — suffix 3 masculine singular סוּתֹה Gen 49:11 (poem in J; || לְבֻשׁוֺ ).
